api.operations: operations()-> ordered global records including epoch/task/request/call/local ordinal, parsed method request, terminal and result

engine_binding.host_guard: activate/merge guard must close over the engine's current RunContext lease/time/bindings. Broker also checks current schedule/run claim before and after guarded effects.
engine_binding.tool_caps: Context.status tools_reserved/max_tool_calls; one persistent global stream, never reset.

layout.broker_stages: Fixed leader/worker-1/worker-2 each case/inputs/work plus stage.json; metadata and epochs subdirectories.
layout.broker_tools: Original exact method/core launcher and D113 analyzer. Engine must bind this immutable tools directory as well as broker_stages.
layout.case_copy_reason: Original method requires case.parent == inputs.parent == work.parent; copies occur once per role, never per epoch. No symlink/hardlink redirection.
layout.epoch_artifacts: Immutable base_state.json and merged_state.json, append-only activation/merge metadata. Fixed worker workspaces are reset only by declared host activation transitions.
layout.stream: run_dir/tool_reservations/*.json, tool_receipts/*.json and broker/NNNN/{stdout,stderr}; same ordinals across roles and epochs.

controls: Common original tool bytes across A/B/C; mode fixed by the immutable arm_prompt and manifest.
Host enforces canonical original operation and node/file scope before reservation/launch; scope rechecked inside broker lock.
Leader init once; workers no init/advance/approve, only owned revise/review and disjoint deliverables; reviewer receives no tools.
Pending norm enforcement and method replay use the unchanged mode-aware kernel/core; A unsafe accepted downstream remains observable, not relabeled corrupt.
One/two workers selected by deterministic original-mode readiness policy; empty selection is not fabricated.
Actual local sandbox, current claim and immutable sources/staged public inputs checked before/after effects.
Host transition intent is durable; an orphan intent/partial tool or staging artifact blocks effects and is never silently repaired.
Replay binds raw streams, exact record schema, counters/call IDs, per-role inventories, initialization, mode/core headers and method states; host merged state must equal original kernel replay.
Readonly analyzer writes metrics through host only; ordinary errors retire prior metrics. All nonmetrics work inventory must match the producer for current_metrics.
Merge always retires leader metrics and never transfers branch metrics as final leader metrics.
Conflicting ownership has no silent file winner; globals of previous brokers/core are never patched.

limits: Same-UID cooperating harness, not a hostile-code/host administrator boundary or authenticated execution receipt.
Unit transports/context lease are explicitly synthetic; tools/analyzer/sandbox effects are real, no provider/model/paid calls occurred.

Metrics prove current host-produced finite JSON provenance only, not scientific truth, delivery semantics, Q, field efficacy or normative approval.
Formal DEV remains 0/24; root owns prospective runtime/HTTP/CLI evidence and final freeze/review.
